description:
About the job

Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary Range: $900 to $1,500 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned DTC eyewear brand known for innovative, problem-solving sunglasses and bold product design. Our slogan, “sunglasses with a solution,” reflects our focus on function, style, and constant improvement. We’ve built a global customer base and a highly engaged social community of over 250,000 followers, driven by founder-led storytelling, product innovation, and performance-driven content.




We operate as a lean, high-performance team where speed, ownership, and results are the standard. We move fast, test constantly, and prioritize revenue impact over surface-level activity.




The Role

We're looking for a strategic, highly organized, and relationship-driven Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist to help grow one of TopFoxx's most important revenue channels.




Success in this role isn't determined by how many influencers you recruit, it's measured by your ability to build strong relationships, activate creators, generate consistent content, and drive profitable revenue.




While experience in influencer or affiliate marketing is valuable, we're equally interested in candidates with exceptional communication, persuasion, and marketing skills who are eager to learn. If you're naturally proactive, enjoy building relationships, think strategically, and know how to motivate people, we want to hear from you.




This role requires someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership, builds themselves to be the expert in their field and enjoys improving systems while delivering measurable business results.




Core Responsibilities




1) Affiliate Recruitment & Relationship Management

Build and scale a large affiliate creator network across TikTok, Instagram, LTK, and other relevant platforms.
Recruit, onboard, and develop creators with the goal of building a network of 5,000+ affiliates.
Build meaningful relationships with creators through personalized outreach and ongoing communication.
Develop long-term partnerships that encourage consistent posting and repeat collaboration.
Keep creators engaged by providing timely support, product recommendations, campaign updates, and performance feedback.
Re-engage inactive affiliates and maintain a healthy, active creator pipeline.




2) Affiliate Growth & Performance

Build and grow a high-performing affiliate network focused on consistent revenue generation rather than vanity metrics.
Monitor affiliate activity, posting frequency, conversions, and overall performance.
Identify top-performing creators and develop strategies to scale their success.
Analyze underperforming partnerships and make recommendations to improve results or discontinue collaborations.
Continuously optimize commission structures, gifting strategies, incentives, and creator engagement to maximize ROI.




3) Campaign & Program Management

Coordinate gifting campaigns, product launches, seasonal promotions, and creator initiatives.
Support TikTok Live scheduling and collaboration opportunities with affiliates.
Ensure creators receive accurate information, products, tracking, and campaign materials.
Maintain organized workflows and ensure campaigns are executed on time.




4) Data, Reporting & Optimization

Maintain accurate CRM records, affiliate databases, and outreach tracking.
Monitor key performance indicators including revenue, GMV, conversion rate, posting activity, ROI, and affiliate retention.
Prepare clear reports identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Use data to recommend new strategies, improve efficiency, and support profitable program growth.




5) Systems & Continuous Improvement

Develop SOPs, templates, and scalable processes that improve efficiency.
Stay informed on creator trends, platform updates, and emerging marketing opportunities.
Test new outreach strategies, partnership ideas, and growth initiatives.
Support additional marketing and growth projects as business needs evolve.




Requirements & Experience

Required

Excellent written and spoken English.
Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.
Strong persuasion and negotiation abilities.
Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.
Strategic marketing mindset with a focus on measurable business results.
Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret performance data.
Ability to manage multiple projects and conversations simultaneously.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
Comfortable learning new platforms, tools, and systems quickly.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and initiative.

Preferred

Experience in Influencer Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, Partnership Marketing, or related marketing roles.
Experience working with creators, influencers, or online communities.
Familiarity with eCommerce platforms.
Experience building workflows, SOPs, or scalable marketing processes.
Understanding of digital marketing, consumer behavior, and conversion optimization.




Who You Are

Entrepreneurial: You spot opportunities others miss and act on them, solving problems without waiting for direction
Growth-Obsessed: You want to be the best in your field, not just good at the job, so you teach yourself relentlessly and treat becoming the go-to expert as a personal standard
Competitive Greatness: You're driven to be the best and you bring your A-game when it matters most, especially under pressure
Analytical: You think in ROI, margins, and performance, not vanity metrics
Persuasive: You understand creator psychology and know how to motivate consistent posting and sales
Creative Differentiator: You know the market is oversaturated, so you find creative ways to cut through: your communication style, the genuine care you bring to your creators and the product, and how thoughtfully you present and place it
Execution-Focused: You can manage high volume without losing structure or quality
Professional: You're the face of TopFoxx to every creator you touch, so you communicate with polish, follow through on what you promise, and represent the brand with care
Ownership Mentality: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks




Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience with performance bonuses
Performance-based bonuses tied to results
Fully remote work
PTO + paid holidays
Free TopFoxx products
Clear path to a leadership role




While experience in Influencer Marketing or Affiliate Marketing is valuable, it is not the only path to success in this role. We are looking for someone with exceptional communication skills, strong marketing judgment, and the ability to build relationships and persuade people. The right person may come from influencer marketing, partnerships, sales, community management, brand marketing, or another field where communication and strategic thinking drive results.




This is a high-ownership, performance-driven role. You will be responsible for building a real revenue engine, not managing surface-level influencer activity. If you are motivated by growth, ownership, and measurable impact and know how to build profitable affiliate systems, we want to meet you!




Don't see the perfect fit? If you believe you'd be a great addition to TopFoxx but this role isn't the best match, we'd still love to hear from you. Please email your resume and a brief introduction to recruiting@topfoxx.com and let us know which role(s) you're interested in. We're always excited to connect with exceptional talent.

title: Senior Email and CRM Manager
description:
About the job

Senior Email and CRM Manager

Salary: $30K/annually




PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH!




About the Role

We're looking for a senior level Email and CRM Specialist to own all Klaviyo flows and campaigns across our brand portfolio. This includes ongoing lifecycle and retention email for our subscription brands, repeat purchase focused campaigns for our single purchase brand, and building out retailer facing email communication for our wholesale brand, which currently has no email program at all. You will work hands on in Klaviyo daily, and you need to already know how to build flows and campaigns independently, this is not a role where Klaviyo experience gets learned on the job.




About Us

We are a multi brand pet products company operating across subscription DTC, single purchase DTC, and wholesale models, each with different customer relationships and different email needs.




What You'll Do

Own and continuously improve Klaviyo flows for our subscription brands, including welcome series, abandoned cart, replenishment reminders, win back campaigns, and cancellation flow support

Build and manage repeat purchase focused email campaigns for our single purchase brand, including new release announcements and post purchase engagement, directly supporting a known gap in how email has been used for that brand

Build retailer facing email communication for our wholesale brand, directed at retail buyers and accounts who purchase wholesale, not end consumers, since no email program currently exists for this brand

Run ongoing A/B tests across flows and campaigns, including subject lines, send timing, content, and segmentation, and use results to continuously improve performance rather than treating any flow as finished

Optimize signup forms to maximize list acquisition, engagement, and downstream revenue

Develop content calendars aligned with each brand's objectives and release timing

Manage Klaviyo account infrastructure, integrations, and segmentation setup across all brands

Conduct regular Klaviyo audits and resolve issues involving deliverability, responsive design, dynamic tagging, and personalization

Perform quality assurance checks on every campaign and flow before send, catching rendering, link, and personalization errors before they reach customers

Monitor and analyze lifecycle and email marketing performance using Klaviyo Analytics and Google Analytics, and generate clear, accurate reporting on results

Provide data driven recommendations to improve performance and return on investment across all brands

Coordinate with each brand's manager to translate their requirements into fully built Klaviyo campaigns and flows




What We're Looking For

Minimum three years managing or heavily involved in an email retention marketing program for a B2C ecommerce brand

Hands on Klaviyo experience is required, including expert level proficiency, custom flow logic, complex segmentation, and predictive analytics features, you must already know how to independently build both flows and campaigns without ramp up time

Experience with SMS, push, or direct mail retention marketing in addition to email is a plus

Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for email design and customization

Familiarity with CRM or CDP tools, ecommerce platforms such as Shopify, and Google Analytics

Required, hands on experience with a company that manufactures, ships, or fulfills a physical product to consumers

Strongly preferred, experience with a subscription or autoship product model

Strongly preferred, experience in the pet industry

Strong analytical skills with a track record of turning data into concrete revenue generating recommendations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, detail oriented, and comfortable managing multiple brands and priorities simultaneously

Self motivated and proactive, with proven success working independently in a remote environment




Work Style

Reports directly to the CEO

Supports our full brand portfolio, spanning subscription DTC, single purchase DTC, and wholesale

Fast paced, highly collaborative, and results driven environment

description:
About the job

Hey, Dingus!




Yeah, you heard that right.




Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a Brand Operator to join our growing team! You’re probably thinking, “Wtf is a Brand Operator?” Keep reading. 👀




Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency, but here’s the thing most agencies won’t tell you: having a website isn’t a strategy. Neither is posting on Instagram three times a week. A blog without a traffic plan is a diary. A newsletter nobody opens is a chore. Every tactic we run exists to answer one question: how does this move someone from ”never heard of you” to “shut up and take my money”? That’s the job. Blogs feed SEO. SEO feeds traffic. Traffic feeds the funnel. The funnel feeds revenue. If a tactic doesn’t connect to that chain, we don’t run it just to look busy. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription, minus the shit that doesn’t get anyone anywhere.




Purpose of the Role




The Brand Operator combines client relationship ownership with hands-on marketing production. You are the client’s main point of contact and one of the people actually making the work happen. This role exists because most agencies force clients to choose between “someone who understands your brand” and “someone who can execute.” We don’t think that tradeoff should exist, and neither will you.




About You




Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
Multifaceted, someone who steps up to the challenge
Proactive, always thinking about the needs of a client before they are
Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
Professional level of English (written and spoken)
Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful — you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
A background in marketing is essential
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, specifically) as part of your daily workflow as a way to move faster and think better




The Skill Requirements




You need real, hands-on proficiency in at least 3–4 of the following:




Short-form video editing (Reels, TikTok, etc)
Social media strategy, content creation, and scheduling
Newsletter writing and editing
Brand strategy and positioning
Copywriting (web, ads, email, social)
Design fundamentals (Canva, Figma, or similar)
Basic analytics and reporting (knowing what a number means, not just where to find it)




Coordination skills alone will not meet the bar for this role. We already know you can manage a project. We need to know what you can build.




Main Objectives




1. Client Relationship Ownership

Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, understanding their goals well enough to make calls without needing a meeting first
Run regular check-ins, reviews, and strategy conversations that actually move the account forward, not just status updates
Translate client goals into a point of view, not just a task list




2. Hands-On Production

Personally execute against your core skills (video, social, newsletter, copy, brand, design, wherever you excel)
Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up ideation, drafting, and iteration. We want to see how you think with AI as a collaborator, not just how fast you can type a prompt
Maintain a quality bar on your own output before it goes to review, not after




3. Internal Collaboration

Work with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other Operators to fill gaps outside your core skills
Keep project tools (ClickUp and similar) current and accurate without needing to be chased
Give and receive direct feedback — we skip the sandwich method here




4. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Help shape brand and marketing strategy for your accounts, not just execute against someone else’s plan
Continuously look for workflow improvements, especially ones involving AI, that let you do more without more hours
Manage multiple accounts without letting them quietly rot




Important Notes

Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.
The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional.




Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

About the job

Offshore SDR / Lead Generation Specialist (Recruitment) – Remote




Fully remote, full-time, US hours




A specialist recruitment firm is looking for a sales development rep to build and run its outbound engine. You'd work directly with the founder, with real ownership from week one. You will ideally have a SAAS, ERP or Tech background. But we are open to all sorts.




The role is centered on prospecting, list building and outreach campaigns that generate qualified conversations for the founder, with some marketing and candidate delivery support around it. If you're relentless about pipeline, write clean and persuasive outreach, and like seeing your work turn into booked meetings, this is built for you.




What you'd actually do




Build and clean targeted prospect lists of hiring managers and decision-makers
Research target accounts and prepare briefing notes so every outreach touch is relevant
Set up and run multi-channel outbound campaigns (email, LinkedIn) in Smartlead and our CRM
Write and test outreach sequences, subject lines and follow-ups to improve reply and meeting-booked rates
Qualify inbound and outbound leads against our ideal client profile
Book discovery calls onto the founder's calendar and hand off with full context
Track all activity and keep the CRM and pipeline data clean and current
Support marketing and candidate delivery when needed: newsletters, social posts and shortlists




You will not be closing deals or negotiating fees. That stays with the founder. Your job is to fill the top of funnel, keep the pipeline full of qualified conversations, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.




Who this suits




You've run SDR, lead gen or sales development for a company.
Your written English is genuinely excellent. This is non-negotiable, you'll be writing outreach that lands in a stranger's inbox
You know how to build a prospect list, sequence outreach and read reply-rate data

You like systems, lists and knowing exactly where every lead is up to
Recruitment industry exposure is a plus, not a requirement




Practical bits




Fully remote, you can be based anywhere, but you must work US business hours

Structured six-month ramp-up with training across outbound, tools and the recruitment business

Modern stack (Claude, Smartlead, and modern outreach and CRM tools), and you'll learn to use it properly

Results-focused: booked meetings and pipeline generated, not hours-logged




How to apply




Send your resume and a short note telling us why this role fits. Applicants that send a video are more likely to be selected for interview.

description:
About the job

About Neticca:

Neticca is a technology and data consulting company. We help growing companies solve engineering and data problems, and we're building out our internal team to support that work. You'll join Neticca directly, supported by our internal systems, mentorship, and Center of Excellence, with structured onboarding and long-term growth.




About the Role

We're hiring an Account & Delivery Manager to serve as the primary day-to-day liaison between our customers, our technical delivery team, and company leadership.

This is a highly customer-facing role combining relationship management, project coordination, and requirements gathering. You'll develop a strong understanding of each customer's business objectives, capture their requirements, coordinate ongoing delivery, and communicate with technical resources — helping identify where Neticca can provide additional support.

This is not a technical engineering position, but prior experience working with technology, data, IT, software, or technical implementations is strongly preferred.




Core Responsibilities

· Act as a consistent, professional point of contact for customers, leading or participating in recurring customer meetings and project discussions.

· Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders and communicate project progress, dependencies, and next steps.

· Listen for new requirements and business needs, ask effective follow-up questions, and document them clearly for leadership and the technical team.

· Maintain visibility into project milestones, deliverables, and open items; track action items and escalate risks or blockers when needed.

· Coordinate communication between customers and technical resources, ensuring nothing gets lost between meetings.

· Identify potential new opportunities during customer conversations and bring them to company leadership for scoping.

· Partner with leadership on new engagements — owning discovery, requirements, and customer communication while leadership owns solution design, pricing, and contracting.




Must-Have Qualifications

· Fluent in English and Spanish, both required. English: native/primary-language level. Spanish: professional fluency — you'll work directly with Spanish-speaking engineers.

· 3–6+ years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Technical Account Manager, Account & Delivery Manager, Project Manager, IT Project Manager, Business Analyst, or Customer Success Manager within a technology or consulting organization.

· Comfortable working with technical concepts — data and databases, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, reporting/BI — at a conversational level, without needing to perform the technical work directly.

· Strong organizational skills and follow-through on project coordination, documentation, and action items.

· Available for scheduled customer meetings during US Eastern/Central business hours.

· Comfortable working independently with limited supervision and collaborating with distributed, international technical teams.




Nice to Have

· Prior experience in a customer-facing role at a technology consulting or professional services firm.

· Experience working directly with developers, data teams, or IT organizations.

· Track record of spotting and developing account expansion opportunities.

· Familiarity with project tools such as Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or Notion.




Why Join Neticca?

· Competitive Compensation: We offer a competitive contractor rate for top-tier talent.

· Ground-Level Impact: As a key customer-facing hire, you'll shape how we manage and grow our customer relationships.

· Career Growth: Grow with a company that invests in your development and values your expertise.

· Innovative Work Environment: Join a team that values creativity, collaboration, and cutting-edge solutions.

About the job

This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Why you should join the Adyen Account Management team

At Adyen, the Account Management team is critical to the growth and success of our business, as well as expanding the Adyen brand across the globe. Being part of our Account Management team, you’ll manage relationships with innovative international merchants, covering multiple industries and channels. You’ll have the opportunity to work on cross-functional initiatives and projects in a fast-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment with high autonomy. You’ll become an expert in the global payments landscape and level up your skills through our AM Academy.

We are looking for a proactive and adaptable Account Manager to join our team in Mexico City. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with a hands-on mentality; someone who is eager to help the world’s biggest brands grow while changing an industry. You are excited to work with a global, multicultural team in a collaborative manner and help your team succeed. Your focus will be on delivering an outstanding customer experience, finding new opportunities, and driving mutual success for Adyen and our customers.

Enterprise Account Manager

As Account Manager at Adyen, you will manage our largest enterprise merchants by building strong relationships with key merchant contacts. The ideal candidate is a born networker who thrives in a fast-paced, diverse and entrepreneurial environment. You'll be managing relationships with local and international merchants across multiple industries and channels, so life is never dull! You will understand the unique needs of a merchant and provide them with payments expertise and guidance to help them grow.

What You’ll Do


Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise merchants, meeting our team’s strategic and financial goals
Build strong merchant relationships and navigate their organizations to align the right external and internal stakeholders
Provide strategic and consultative advice to help influence and fulfill the global payments strategy of enterprise companies
Collaborate cross-functionally to communicate merchant needs and feedback, impacting Adyen’s product innovation and development, and delivering merchant projects
Proactively foster a positive working environment for our business and maintain good relationships with external and internal stakeholders


Who You Are


You're dynamic, hands-on self-starter with a proven commercial edge and entrepreneurial drive
Enjoy engaging others, working collaboratively, and developing strong working relationships at all levels of management
Passionate about leading strategic payments conversations, presenting business reviews, and coordinating high level technical discussions
Highly skilled in leveraging your business acumen and analytical abilities to strategically assess and help reach client goals
Excited to prioritize and manage multiple projects across different departments, while motivating and collaborating with others to achieve results
You have at least 5 years of experience working exclusively with Enterprise Accounts;
You have full professional proficiency (written and verbal) in English; 
You are available to work 3 days in person at our office.


Additional Details


This role is based out of our Mexico City office. We have a hybrid workplace and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles. 
Some domestic and international travel required


Ready to meet us?

If you are excited about this role, apply by clicking the link below. We can’t wait to meet you.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Mexico City office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.




Your New Role:
The Business Analyst is responsible for the planning and execution throughout the lifecycle of one or more software solutions within the business domain. This includes creating and prioritizing product and business requirements and working closely with business and technology teams to ensure business stakeholder and end user satisfaction goals are met. He or she will create and develop requirements and concepts for product enhancements in support of business and technology needs. This position provides a wide variety of services to our business users including business analysis and quality assurance, in support of strategic and tactical planning of systems features / functionality as well as day to day business operations. The role also entails Project Management for software releases and managing of SOX processes and documentation.




Your Role Accountabilities:




Business Analysis

Collaborate with key business stakeholders to generate business requirements based on use cases/user stories. Prioritize and scope based on business input and ROI. 
Lead collaboration with the global teams to assure incorporation of global requirements for enhancements when prioritized and justified related to regional requirements. Assure no negative impact to global regional workflows.
Collaborate with internal engineering, vendor engineering, internal technical teams and external technical teams to assure vendor and technical designs cover mandatory business requirements.
Serve as primary contact for the business for the support of system functionality, business process and workflow and react to emerging or changing revenue opportunities and industry trends.
Lead proof-of-concept priority projects related to new or adjusted business processes to satisfy industry or business adjustments. 
Participate in assessment and feasibility studies of available technologies and recommend solutions.
Manage business and functional requirements for one or more business solutions related to Content Rights, Scheduling, Traffic, Presentation and Reconciliation operations.
Manage relationships with multiple business organizations, global technology groups and 3rd party software vendors including: facilitating requirement and design workshops, reviewing designs, test plans and test cases; reviewing vendor deliverables and schedules; managing quality or delivery issues with the vendor; coordinating end user testing and sign-off for in-house and vendor deliverables.

Functional Testing

Perform functional testing and document workflow and configuration changes related to system and process adjustments based on Proof-of-concept outcomes or business requirements.

Training

Provide a walk thorough of new functionality including both system functionality and region-specific recommended configuration and workflow. Train the trainer.
Assist in the design, delivery, and improvement of in-house training programs and related courseware.

Compliance and Standards

Ensure compliance with Warner Bros. Discovery Software Development Lifecycle documentation and mandated compliance requirements for all application changes.

General

Work independently under minimal supervision.




Qualifications & Experiences:

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent degree/work experience
Experience supporting technology solutions in a Media industry organization
Minimum of 3 years’ experience with mid to large-scale software development projects – understanding all phases of systems development
Strong prioritization and organization skills
Strong presentation and communication skills; excellent listening skills, ability to interface with business customers at all levels of the organization
Strong project management skills
Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
Excellent people skills – negotiation, conflict resolution, providing direction and focus
Ability to work on multiple projects at one time with minimal supervision and to ensure that overall priorities are being met
Proven ability to successfully operate within, and contribute to, a high growth, entrepreneurial, fast paced business and matrix environment.

Preferred qualifications

Experience in Air-Time Sales, Business Intelligence, and Audience Research business areas and respective applications desirable
Formal Business Analysis Training desirable
Experience with AI enabled application business design and usage a plus.




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

You use AI as a core part of how you work, not an occasional tool: fluent with AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Gemini) to accelerate data analysis, reporting, and campaign development, and able to speak concretely to how you already do this today. You expect this of your team too.

description:
About the job

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Regional User Growth Senior Manager, SS-Latam to our User Growth team in Mexico!

As our Regional User Growth Senior Manager, SS-Latam, you'll own User Growth strategy and execution across Mexico, Argentina, and Chile: three distinct markets, one connected growth mandate. You'll lead a dedicated regional team while operating as the primary User Growth partner to our senior Spanish-Speaking Latam Revenue leadership (VPs and directors), translating data into strategy and strategy into hands-on, in-market execution.

This is a senior, highly autonomous role: you'll set the regional growth agenda, build and coach a team, and stay close enough to the work to run the analysis, build the campaign, or fix what isn't working yourself when it matters. We expect you to use AI as a core part of how you and your team operate: accelerating analysis, reporting, and campaign development so you can move faster and go deeper than a traditional growth team. If you're energized by owning a multi-market region end-to-end, building senior stakeholder relationships, and leading with both strategic judgment and hands-on rigor, we'd love to hear from you!

YOUR IMPACT


Own the User Growth strategy for SS-Latam (new members, new paid subscribers, upgrade, and reactivation) building and forecasting the regional B2B2C marketing plan and the KPIs that track it.
Lead, hire, and develop a small regional team, delegating with context and coaching them toward greater ownership and autonomy.
Build and sustain a trust-based partnership with senior SS-Latam Revenue and Customer Success leadership, becoming their go-to partner for growth strategy and a credible voice in regional and cross-functional forums. Linking a deep understanding of Wellhub's client and user journeys to proactively identify areas of underperformance and opportunities in major Latam clients.
Use AI as a core part of how you and your team work: fluent with AI tools to accelerate data analysis, campaign development, reporting, and market research, and comfortable coaching others to do the same.
Stay close to the numbers and the work: pull and interpret your own data, build your own reporting, and get hands-on with campaign execution and QA, partnering with local revenue teams to design cross-channel and cross-functional initiatives to grow enrollment in key clients.
Identify local trends and competitive opportunities market by market, adapting regional strategy to local reality: Mexico, Argentina, and Chile each have their own dynamics. Advocating for regional priorities with your manager (VP of Growth) and global stakeholders within Marketing.
Own campaign calendar towards lifecycle channels (email, app push notifications, SMS/whatsapp) and influence Paid Media agenda (paid social, search, etc.), developing messaging strategies in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders in PMM, Brand, CS, etc, as the subject matter expert on the consumer (subscriber) audience.
Champion experimentation, testing new approaches locally and scaling what works across the region and beyond.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.


Who You Are


You use AI as a core part of how you work, not an occasional tool: fluent with AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Gemini) to accelerate data analysis, reporting, and campaign development, and able to speak concretely to how you already do this today. You expect this of your team too.
A seasoned growth/marketing leader with significant experience owning end-to-end strategy for a region or multi-market portfolio, ideally in a CRM/lifecycle or subscription-growth context, with experience with Braze or other campaign orchestration tools.
A strong analytical operator, just as comfortable pulling and interpreting your own data as directing someone else to, understanding data sources (Looker, Metabase, databases) and tech stack (CDP, DMP, Amplitude, Segment) and leveraging this knowledge to proactively identify trends and areas of opportunities.
A confident stakeholder manager who builds trust with senior, cross-functional, and executive audiences, translates complex ideas into simple narratives, and navigates high-stakes conversations calmly.
A hands-on leader who moves fluidly between strategy and execution: building the plan, then rolling up your sleeves to help build the campaign, run the analysis, or fix what's not working. As well as a strategic thinker with strong prioritization skills, who connects daily execution to business impact and knows how to prioritize when everything feels urgent.
A people leader who coaches for growth, builds psychological safety, and holds a team accountable to real outcomes, not just activity.
Fluent in English (our team's working language for all cross-functional exchanges) and professionally fluent in Spanish, given the day-to-day work across Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.
Availability to travel to the other regional markets (ie. Argentina) 1-2/year if needed.

description:
About the job

Location: Mexico City

Reports to: CEO

Scope: SARELLY Mexico, with potential broader regional responsibilities over time




MISSION

Make SARELLY the strongest and most innovative beauty brand online in Mexico.

The Online Sales Director will lead SARELLY’s entire digital commercial ecosystem — from DTC and marketplaces to social commerce and the e-commerce performance of our retail partners.

This is not a channel-management role. It is a growth leadership role.

You will be responsible for defining where the next wave of digital growth will come from, building the strategy to capture it, and mobilizing Commercial, Marketing, Content, Community, Operations and Data around it.

Because digital is often where new consumer behaviors, products and commercial models emerge first, this role is also designed as a potential stepping stone toward broader Mexico General Management responsibilities.




ABOUT SARELLY

SARELLY is a fast-growing, entertainment-native beauty brand born in Mexico, building the next generation of beauty for a global audience.

Founded by creator and entrepreneur Anna Sarelly, SARELLY sits at the intersection of beauty, entertainment, community and commerce. We don't just launch products — we create cultural moments around them, combining product innovation, creator-led storytelling and a highly engaged community.

Since launching beauty in 2023, SARELLY has rapidly expanded from DTC into social commerce, marketplaces and physical retail. Today, the brand is present at leading beauty retailers including Sephora and Ulta in Mexico and is entering its next phase of international growth, including a major U.S. retail expansion.

Digital has been part of SARELLY's DNA from day one. Our products have become best sellers on platforms including TikTok Shop, while our entertainment and creator ecosystem gives us a unique ability to turn cultural relevance into commercial performance.

As we enter our next stage, we want to build one of the most innovative digital commerce engines in beauty in Mexico — and are looking for a leader who can help us define what that looks like.




1. OWN THE ONLINE BUSINESS

Own the strategy, commercial performance and P&L across SARELLY’s digital channels in Mexico:

SARELLY.com
Mercado Libre
Amazon
TikTok Shop
Emerging marketplaces and social-commerce channels
E-commerce business of key retail partners, including Sephora and Ulta

Build one integrated digital commercial strategy while defining the distinct role, consumer mission and economics of each channel.

Own revenue, profitability, traffic, conversion, AOV, repeat purchase, assortment and promotional strategy.

Set ambitious annual and quarterly targets and translate them into clear commercial plans and priorities.




2. CREATE THE NEXT GROWTH ENGINES

Don't just execute an existing playbook — create the next one.

Continuously identify, test and scale new opportunities across:

Platforms and emerging channels
Commercial models
Assortments, bundles and exclusives
Launch and promotional mechanics
Affiliate and creator-commerce programs
Live-shopping formats
CRM and retention initiatives
Partnerships and technology

Stay ahead of shifts in consumer behavior, platform capabilities and commerce innovation, turning successful experiments into scalable and profitable businesses.




3. MAKE SARELLY A DIGITAL COMMERCE CASE STUDY

Our ambition is for SARELLY to become a reference for how the next generation of beauty brands wins online.

The question should constantly be:

“What can SARELLY do online that other beauty brands are not doing yet?”

Partner closely with Marketing, Content, Community and Creator teams to develop commercial ideas that are culturally relevant, entertaining and native to each platform.

Use SARELLY’s entertainment and community ecosystem as a competitive advantage, connecting content, creators and commerce rather than treating e-commerce as simply the final transactional step of a marketing funnel.

Build ideas and capabilities in Mexico that can ultimately inspire SARELLY's approach in other markets.




4. TURN SOCIAL COMMERCE INTO A CORE CAPABILITY

Make TikTok Shop and emerging social-commerce channels major engines for both revenue and customer acquisition.

Define and continuously optimize the right combination of:

Organic content
Affiliate creators
Paid amplification
Live commerce
Product seeding
Promotions
Exclusive drops
Hero-SKU strategies

Work hand in hand with Marketing and Community so commercial insights influence content decisions — and content insights translate into commercial opportunities.

Build a repeatable social-commerce model that can scale with the brand.




5. WIN ON MARKETPLACES

Build differentiated strategies for Mercado Libre and Amazon, recognizing them as strategic businesses rather than secondary distribution channels.

Own and optimize:

Assortment and pricing architecture
Product pages and digital content
Search visibility
Retail media
Promotions
Ratings and reviews
Inventory availability
Conversion
Marketplace-specific launches and activations

Understand the different consumer missions and economics of each marketplace and adapt SARELLY’s approach accordingly.

Develop strong relationships with platform teams and position SARELLY as a priority and innovative beauty partner.




6. WIN ON OUR RETAILERS' DIGITAL SHELVES

Make SARELLY as powerful online within our retail partners as it is in their physical stores.

Partner with the Wholesale team to lead the digital growth agenda at retailers such as Sephora and Ulta, bringing dedicated e-commerce expertise while Wholesale remains the owner of the overall retailer relationship.

Drive excellence across:

Digital assortment and availability
Product pages and content
Search and discoverability
Ratings and reviews
Retail media
Digital launches and promotions
CRM opportunities
Retailer-specific activations

Develop joint digital growth plans with strategic retailers and make their e-commerce businesses meaningful growth engines for SARELLY.




7. CONNECT MARKETING, CULTURE AND COMMERCE

Act as a key commercial partner to the Mexico Marketing team, translating consumer, content and platform signals into growth opportunities.

Bring proactive ideas, not just briefs:

“We are seeing this behavior on TikTok — what should we launch around it?”

“This product is accelerating on Mercado Libre — how do we amplify it?”

“This creator mechanic is converting — how do we scale it?”

“This retailer has an untapped digital opportunity — what can we propose?”

Constantly connect what consumers are watching, talking about and searching for with what they ultimately buy.




8. BUILD THE OPERATING MODEL TO SCALE

Create the data, dashboards and commercial rituals required to make faster and better decisions.

Build a clear view across channels of:

Net sales and growth
Gross and contribution margin
Traffic and conversion
AOV
CAC / ROAS where relevant
New vs. repeat customers
Sell-through
Inventory and OOS
Search performance
Affiliate performance
Content-to-commerce conversion
Retail media performance

Build a culture that goes beyond reporting what happened to understanding why it happened, what we learned and what we should do next.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within 12–24 months:

SARELLY has built a significantly larger, more diversified and more profitable online business.

TikTok Shop, Mercado Libre and Amazon have become major growth engines, while SARELLY.com has evolved into an increasingly sophisticated platform for acquisition, conversion and retention.

SARELLY is consistently one of the strongest-performing beauty brands online within its strategic retail partners.

The company has developed distinctive capabilities around entertainment-driven, creator-driven and social commerce, with successful ideas continuously tested, measured and scaled.

Most importantly, platforms, retailers and the beauty industry increasingly recognize SARELLY as a case study for how the next generation of beauty brands wins online in Mexico.




THE PROFILE

We are looking for a builder, not a channel administrator.

Someone commercially ambitious, digitally native and highly analytical — but equally capable of generating ideas, taking calculated risks and challenging how things have traditionally been done.

Ideally, this person has:

Significant e-commerce and marketplace experience in Mexico
Proven ownership of meaningful online revenue and P&L
Strong experience with Amazon and/or Mercado Libre
Hands-on understanding of TikTok Shop, social commerce or creator-led commerce
Experience working with major retailers' e-commerce businesses
Strong commercial and analytical capabilities
Solid understanding of digital marketing and retail media
Experience managing teams and external partners
The ability to influence and operate cross-functionally across Marketing, Content, Operations and Finance
An entrepreneurial mindset and appetite to build, experiment and move fast

Beauty experience is valuable, but digital commercial excellence, leadership potential and entrepreneurial mindset matter more than category pedigree.




LEADERSHIP EXPECTATION

This role is designed for someone with the ambition and potential to grow beyond e-commerce.

Digital is often where SARELLY sees consumer trends first, tests new ideas first and learns fastest. That makes this position a unique vantage point into the broader Mexico business.

For the right leader, the scope could progressively evolve from:

Online Sales Director

→ broader Commercial leadership

→ potential General Manager Mexico

To make that progression possible, we expect this person to think beyond their immediate channels from day one — developing a strong understanding of the consumer, brand, wholesale, physical retail, operations, profitability and overall performance of SARELLY Mexico.

The ultimate expectation is not simply to run online sales.

It is to help build the future commercial model of SARELLY.

He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Employee Type

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

About the job

Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC, a global leader in technology market intelligence, is seeking a market researcher to join our team. This role requires a mix of analytical abilities, attention to detail, proficiency in research methodologies, alongside excellent communication skills to convey complex information effectively.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in interpreting data, staying abreast of IT market trends and events, supporting their team with in-depth research, and working collaboratively to meet research objectives.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in supporting the authorship and delivery of IDC’s market intelligence products and services in a rapidly evolving information technology landscape. The role will focus on utilizing the latest market research methodologies and tools to uncover relevant data from internal and external data sources and synthesizing into market research content assets.

What You’ll Do


 Support IDC’s market research agenda by conducting in-depth primary and secondary research into IT markets and their impact on industries, namely energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing. 
 Have in-depth knowledge/experience and understanding in energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing business operations, either through working in these industries or executing consulting/research engagements 
 Track, monitor, and identify IT industry developments to identify and report on market shifts, patterns, and anomalies.

 Participate in ongoing professional development and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

Outstanding written and strong verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple assignments and meet tight deadlines.

Flexibility to work both independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.

Experience working with or for technology vendors, IT distributors, or in a market research/consulting firm.

Knowledge of business models, go-to-market strategies, and technology adoption patterns in enterprise IT.
Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new marker research methods and tools, analytical mindset, and a collaborative, supportive approach to teamwork.


Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. About the job

About Glia

Glia is the #1 Banking AI platform, empowering community and regional financial institutions to create efficiencies, accelerate loan growth, drive deposits, and deliver experiences that win against megabanks and fintechs.

Glia's Banking AI Operating System is a central intelligence layer on top of existing tech stacks, activating an AI workforce of specialized agents that draw from banking data, interaction history, and integrated systems of record. These banking-trained agents automate workflows across voice and digital–from front office to back office–resulting in decreased operational costs and the Universal Banker model.

Trusted by 700+ banks and credit unions for its ironclad security and reliability, Glia delivers the industry’s first contractual no-hallucination guarantee. It’s why Glia customers quickly and confidently put Banking AI to work with measurable results from day one. More information about Glia can be found at glia.com.

The Role

At Glia, we believe banking is personal—and our marketing should be too. As the Experiential Marketing Coordinator, you will play a key supporting role in bringing our experiential strategy to life. You will support the planning and execution of high-impact marketing experiences—spanning in-person events like executive summits, conferences, and event activations, as well as highly engaging virtual experiences such as webinars and interactive virtual round tables—all designed to deepen relationships and build pipeline within our defined Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

YOUR ROLE

This position is responsible for driving the execution of strategic franchise initiatives across Latin America, leading efforts to bring WBD’s iconic IPs to life in locally relevant and culturally resonant ways. The role combines project leadership and strategic support with hands-on management of local social media deployment, partnering closely with external vendors and cross-functional teams to ensure content is localized, impactful, and aligned with Global Franchise priorities.

Acting as a connector across teams and markets, the role plays a key part in amplifying WBD’s storytelling, fostering deeper fan engagement, and identifying opportunities to expand reach and impact across LATAM. The position also contributes to building scalable, forward-looking franchise ecosystems, ensuring strong coordination, execution, and alignment across regional and global stakeholders.

Social Media & Digital (50%)

Ensure quality control and consistency of brand voice across platforms.
Monitor performance and provide insights to optimize engagement.
Identify opportunities to strengthen local fan connection and market impact.




Franchise & Project Management (50%)

Work Experience

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we’re a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Braze Specialist to build and ship the lifecycle campaigns that reach patients for a direct-to-consumer telehealth provider delivering primary care across the US. This is a hands-on build role, not a strategy seat — you’ll take approved copy and designs and turn them into clean, well-architected campaigns and Canvases across email, SMS, push, and in-app, with the segmentation, entry criteria, exclusion rules, and frequency capping set up properly the first time. Personalization logic, dynamic content rules, UTMs, and event tracking are all yours, as is the end-to-end QA that catches a broken link or a bad audience rule before a patient ever sees it. You’ll run A/B tests with proper variant control, report on performance weekly, audit existing campaigns for gaps and redundancies, and document every launch with release notes clear enough that the next person can pick it up — all inside a regulated environment where privacy and compliance standards like HIPAA are non-negotiable. A strong fit if you take pride in builds that launch on time and defect-free.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Campaign Build & Launch: Build, configure, and launch CRM campaigns and Canvases across email, SMS, push, and in-app.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring an Email Marketing Strategist (Klaviyo) to own the lifecycle messaging engine for a fast-growing direct-to-consumer cookware and home goods brand heading into its biggest selling season of the year. This is a hands-on, execution-heavy engagement — you’ll audit and optimize the existing Klaviyo flows (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment), build new automations to close the gaps in the customer lifecycle, and run a disciplined testing program across subject lines, send times, content, offers, and flow logic. You’ll also own the weekly SMS calendar and make sure email and SMS work as one coordinated journey rather than two channels competing for the same inbox. The through-line is holiday readiness: building an August–December testing and optimization roadmap, fixing automation gaps before peak traffic hits, tuning segmentation and cadence to lift repeat purchase rate, and flagging risks like deliverability issues, list fatigue, or flow bottlenecks with enough lead time to actually fix them before Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holiday shipping deadlines. A strong fit if you’re the kind of marketer who QAs every send twice, reads statistical significance properly, and would rather ship five well-documented tests than one big untested swing.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

1) Email Automation & Flow Optimization: Audit, maintain, and optimize existing email automations and flows — welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment — and build new automations to fill gaps in the customer lifecycle.

Flow Branching & Segmentation Logic: Design, build, and maintain complex, multi-branch Klaviyo flows utilizing conditional splits, profile filters, and delay logic to ensure highly personalized, non-fatiguing user journeys.
Trigger Mechanics Management: Configure and troubleshoot event-based triggers and profile filters piped from Shopify to Klaviyo (e.g., Active on Site, Viewed Product, Added to Cart). Ensure custom properties and behavioral attributes are mapped perfectly to trigger appropriate sequences without overlap.




2) Testing & Experimentation: Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across subject lines, send times, content, offers, and flow logic/triggers, then recommend and prioritize a testing backlog based on expected impact.




3) QA & Deliverability: QA every flow for deliverability, rendering, links, personalization, and segmentation accuracy before and during peak season, and monitor flow performance to make data-driven adjustments in real time.




4) SMS Program Management: Develop and run SMS tests across messaging, timing, frequency, and offers; own and manage the weekly SMS sending schedule and calendar; and keep SMS and email coordinated rather than conflicting or redundant across the customer journey.




5) Holiday Readiness & Revenue Goals: Build a holiday-specific testing and optimization roadmap for August–December, proactively identify and fix automation gaps before peak traffic hits, and adjust segmentation, targeting, and messaging cadence to support repeat purchase rate and overall revenue goals.




6) Risk Flagging: Surface deliverability issues, list fatigue, and flow bottlenecks with enough lead time to fix them before key selling periods such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holiday shipping deadlines.




7) Reporting & Collaboration: Report weekly on test results, flow performance, and SMS program metrics, and partner with creative/design and merchandising teams to keep content and offers aligned with the promotional calendar.

Deep Analytical Lookback Audits: Leverage Looker, Omni, and Klaviyo data to conduct deep-dive, lookback audits — going beyond basic reporting on delivered, open, click, or unsubscribe rates to investigate the “why” behind flow performance changes, actively identifying customer drop-off bottlenecks in abandonment and post-purchase series.




What You Bring

Email Automation Expertise: Proven experience managing email marketing automation in Klaviyo or a similar ESP, with hands-on ownership of lifecycle flows end to end.
Hands-on Klaviyo Architecture: 3+ years of active, hands-on experience building custom segment triggers, conditional splits, and managing multi-path flow logic within Klaviyo (experience with raw HTML/CSS templates preferred).
SMS Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Klaviyo SMS, Attentive, or Postscript.
Testing & Analytics: A strong understanding of A/B testing methodology and how to read statistical significance, plus an analytical mindset that’s comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data to guide decisions.
Data-Driven Root-Cause Vetting: Strong analytical skills with a proven track record of using BI tools (like Looker or Omni) to perform root-cause analysis on customer journey drop-offs, and comfortable explaining how to diagnose flow underperformance beyond surface-level dashboards.
Segmentation & Lifecycle Strategy: Experience with segmentation strategy and lifecycle marketing, and familiarity with repeat rate, LTV, and revenue-per-recipient as success metrics.
Independent Execution: Comfort working independently in a deadline-driven environment, especially during high-volume holiday periods.
Autonomous Strategic Sourcing: Strong consultative confidence — ability to take a marketing brief, analyze targeting requirements, proactively identify list-fatigue or deliverability risks, and propose alternative testing ideas.
Written Communication: Excellent written communication skills — this is email and SMS copy, after all.




Bonus Points if:

E-commerce/DTC background
Experience with Shopify or similar platforms

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

description:
About the job

📊 Schedulers e Ingenieros de Planeación en México — oportunidad para trabajar en construcción mission-critical en Estados Unidos




Esta oportunidad es para schedulers que quieran dar un salto internacional y trabajar con general contractors que están construyendo data centers, hospitales, laboratorios y la infraestructura física que impulsa la inteligencia artificial y la economía digital en Estados Unidos. Gana entre $85,000 y $180,000 USD anuales.




Buscamos schedulers que sean dueños del programa, no personas que actualizan el programa de alguien más. Vas a ser la persona en quien el equipo confía para saber dónde está realmente la obra, qué está a punto de salirse de control y qué hacer al respecto. Trabajarás hombro a hombro con superintendentes, project managers y estimadores, y estarás frente al owner cada semana.




Perfil que buscamos:

✅ Título profesional en Ingeniería, Construcción, Arquitectura o campo relacionado — o experiencia equivalente comprobable en campo

 ✅ 3+ años de experiencia haciendo scheduling CPM en proyectos de construcción de gran escala — data centers, hospitales, laboratorios, manufactura, infraestructura crítica o comercial complejo. ¿Tienes 2 años y un portafolio sólido de proyectos complejos? Aplica también, queremos conocerte

 ✅ Dominio activo de Primavera P6 (preferido) o Microsoft Project

 ✅ Experiencia desarrollando el baseline schedule y manteniendo actualizaciones mensuales en coordinación directa con superintendentes y el equipo de obra

 ✅ Capacidad para producir look-aheads, reportes de variación, schedules filtrados y narrativas de programa para juntas OAC e internas

 ✅ Experiencia identificando retrasos y desviaciones a tiempo, y proponiendo estrategias de recuperación y mitigación

 ✅ Entendimiento real del proceso constructivo y de cómo se construye lo que está en el plano

 ✅ Conocimiento general de temas comerciales en contratos de construcción: reconocer y documentar change events y retrasos

 ✅ Inglés profesional y disposición para reubicarse en Estados Unidos




Para perfiles senior o lead, valoramos especialmente experiencia en:

⚡ P6 avanzado: resource loading, cost loading, crew logic, database management

 🧊 4D scheduling e integración con modelo BIM

 📐 Preconstrucción: tender schedules a partir de documentos de diseño, constructability reviews, obra falsa y temporary works

 💰 Análisis de aceleración: turnos múltiples, tiempo extra, optimización de costo contra riesgo

 🏭 Facilitación de sesiones de pull planning y planeación colaborativa con subcontratistas y stakeholders

 📊 Delay analysis formal y soporte a reclamaciones

Esta no es una vacante tradicional. Es una oportunidad para entrar al radar de empresas en Estados Unidos que están construyendo a escala masiva y necesitan schedulers de alto nivel con experiencia real en campo. Si estás en la parte temprana de tu carrera pero ya cargas el programa de una obra compleja, este puede ser tu salto.




En 15 minutos puedes dar el primer paso:




 👉 Entra a https://talento.cantera.com/auth/sign-up

 👉 Completa una breve entrevista con nuestro agente de IA

 👉 Empieza a ser visible para empleadores internacionales




Únete a la comunidad de Cantera y conecta tu talento con proyectos globales.




Cantera is a marketplace that connects talented Engineers in Mexico with high-level construction companies in the United States & Canada to power AI, energy and Industrial buildout. Cantera supports its candidates through placement, visa, logistics, certifications and performance.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

Marvel Strike Force is Scopely's squad-based Hero Collector RPG, housing heroes and villains across the Marvel Universe.

What You Will Do

Engage with players (F2P, RCs & VIPs alike) daily across all of our community channels, setting the standard for authentic, high-quality player engagement

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. description:
About the job

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team that includes its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About The Job

As an Associate Account Manager, Central Queue you are the architect of growth for our newest partners, bridging the gap between initial onboarding and long-term success. You will deliver data-driven insights and strategic consulting at scale to empower partners with the tools they need to maximize their impact from day one. In this high-impact role, you will manage a high-volume portfolio to ensure partners meet their goals and realize immediate value within the restaurant ecosystem.

Responsibilities


Act as the primary point of contact for new partners, delivering expert guidance on account optimization and growth strategies. 
Monitor partner performance metrics against established goals to identify underperforming accounts and deploy proactive recovery strategies. 
Orchestrate the central work queue by prioritizing partner needs based on data-driven triggers and potential for business impact. 
Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams to funnel partner feedback into the product roadmap and develop scalable educational resources. 
Identify friction points in the partner journey and propose automation or workflow enhancements to improve overall team efficiency. 
Manage the health of a high-volume restaurant portfolio utilizing automated workflows and personalized interventions to drive retention. 


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
2+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or sales operations. 
Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize a high volume of stakeholders or tasks simultaneously. 
Experience using data analysis to inform business decisions and influence partner strategy. 


Preferred Qualifications


Ability to synthesize complex data into actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. 
Experience influencing senior decision-makers through data-backed storytelling and consultative communication. 
Proficiency with customer relationship management (CRM) tools and a track record of improving operational workflows. 
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills tailored for a professional, remote-first environment. 
Demonstrated success thriving in fast-paced, entrepreneurial, or unstructured environments. 


Benefits and Perks 


Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year 
Focus on mental health and well-being:
Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth 
Company-paid subscription to Headspace 
Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!) 
Paid parental leave 
Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday 
Paid volunteer time 
Focus on your career growth:
Development Dollars 
Leadership development 
Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings 
Travel Discounts 
Employee Resource Groups 
Christmas Bonus - 30 days 
20 days of paid time off a year 
25% vacation premium 
Private health, dental, and life insurance 
Monthly social events and happy hours 

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office —giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Motive is searching for an Account Executive that will be instrumental in building the sales organization from the ground up in our newest regional market, Mexico. As a member of our founding team, you will lead the charge, seizing the opportunity created by our strong product positioning and selling the value of the business outcomes that can be achieved in partnership with Motive. As an Account Executive you are a highly motivated self-starter, possess willingness to learn and embrace continuous improvement, and have a demonstrated history of overachievement in previous sales roles. You have closed large, complex deals in the past, relying on strong interpersonal skills, a deep technical aptitude, and high attention to detail. You have a natural ability to convey and relate ideas to others. Because of the collaborative nature of our Sales team, a win-as-a-team mentality is a must. In this high-energy role, you should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with high standards of quality.

This is a hybrid position based in México City, with occasional travel required for client meetings.

What You'll Do


While supported by a steady stream of inbound leads from SDRs, marketing campaigns, and trade shows, you will be expected to leverage your experience to independently self-prospect and close at least 60% of your sales pipeline.
Prospect and win new business by developing strong relationships with key prospects

Provide recommendations based on a prospect’s business needs and negotiate contract terms.

Effectively plan, in order to meet and exceed ongoing business goals and revenue quotas.
Demonstrated experience consistently applying the MEDDICC framework in daily sales activities. 
Constantly study and deepen understanding of market trends to enable consultative insight

Possess a true sales-hunter mindset—highly disciplined, structured, and capable of executing effectively under pressure
Deep Enterprise sales experience partnering with F1000 clients
7+ years of Enterprise Field Sales experience required
